name: braintrust
summary: I successfully fetched the Braintrust evaluation quickstart docs and installed the Python SDK and dependencies (`braintrust`, `openai`, `autoevals`), with pip reporting “Successfully installed autoevals-0.3.0 braintrust-0.35.0 …”. I also wrote the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly as the quickstart specifies. However, the sandbox cannot establish any outbound TLS connection: `curl -v https://gateway.braintrust.dev` fails with “Connection reset by peer” during the TLS handshake, and even `curl https://google.com` fails the same way. Non-TLS HTTP requests return `403 Forbidden` from an `envoy` proxy, confirming the sandbox blocks external HTTPS traffic. Because the Braintrust SDK must log in to `api.braintrust.dev` and the OpenAI client must reach the gateway to call a model, the eval cannot execute and no scores can be produced.

friction.detail: Quickstart instructs export OPENAI_API_KEY but the sandbox only has BRAINTRUST_API_KEY and grep for openai/anthropic/gemini returns exit=1

friction.where: bt CLI install fails due to network block
friction.detail: curl -fsSL https://bt.dev/cli/install.sh | sh prints curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer
curl -v https://gateway.braintrust.dev fails with OpenSSL SSL_connect: Connection reset by peer and even https://google.com fails identically

friction.where: HTTP fallback blocked by envoy proxy
friction.detail: curl http://httpbin.org/get returns < HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden and < server: envoy
Script uses base_url=https://gateway.braintrust.dev while SDK source references api_url: https://api.braintrust.ai and api.braintrust.dev
